candidates.copy: An AI demo can look finished right up until its first timeout. The useful question: can it tell you which steps actually ran?
candidates.novel_angle: Observability matters more than impressive technical headlines

candidates.copy: The most expensive part of an AI workflow might be the hour you spend guessing what it did. I'd rather see the execution trail than another flashy diagram.
candidates.novel_angle: Quantify the hidden cost of diagnosing failure without making up a metric
